access.title: Access
access.description: Control who can talk to this agent from the web widget and help page.
access.publicHint: Anyone on an allowed domain can chat. The widget token stays in the embed.
access.privateHint: Website visitors cannot reach this agent until it is Public.
access.widgetTokenDescription: Required in website embeds. Rotate it if it was exposed.
access.rotateDescription: Existing embeds using the current token will stop working until you update them.
access.apiTokenLinkLabel: Manage the API token in Deploy

domains.title: Allowed domains
domains.description: When set, the widget and help page only work on these hostnames. Leave empty to allow any site.
domains.hint: One hostname per line. No https://. Add each subdomain separately.

rateLimit.title: Abuse limits
rateLimit.description: Cap how many web-chat messages one visitor can send per minute.
rateLimit.none: Leave empty for no extra cap. Dashboard preview is not limited.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control what this agent stores from conversations and calls.
privacy.recordingConsentDescription: Play a short “this call may be recorded” line at the start of voice calls.
privacy.saveRecordingsDescription: Keep audio in call history. Transcripts are still stored.
privacy.retentionDescription: Automatically delete this agent’s conversations after the selected period.
privacy.piiRedactionDescription: Mask emails, phones, card numbers, and ID numbers when saving transcripts.
privacy.neverCollectDescription: Always on. The agent will not ask for payment cards, PINs, or passwords.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Safety rules applied on every turn, independently of the system prompt.
guardrails.stayOnTopicDescription: Decline unrelated questions and steer back to this business.
guardrails.refuseSensitive: Refuse medical, legal, and financial advice
guardrails.refuseSensitiveDescription: Do not diagnose, give legal counsel, or offer personalized financial advice.
guardrails.escalateWhenUnsureDescription: If the agent is not confident, it offers a human instead of guessing.

personality.customToneDescription: Optional extra style, for example “warm Darija, short sentences”.
